content.content: 1. Necessity: the guard needs the birth promise for the argument surface it gates — without it, refusing an unnameable argument is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The malformed-argument refusal is where the form's named parts meet the birth; the gate keeps the use sound without testing refusal itself.
